The annual beauty pageant of the Alps takes place on the 2nd Saturday of August in Kelmend region and features traditional costumes and regional delicacies.
a historic building home to royal family members built in 1916 and now converted into a museum. It provides good glimpse to old infrastructure of Dubai.

The largest market in the region, Bodbiskhevi offers the traditional Soviet Sunday market day experience. At Bodbiskhevi market the prices and variety of goods are unmatched, selling such things as fresh produce, meats, cheeses,…
It was established in November 1930 as part of the Soviet Arctic and Antarctic Research Institute, but was not opened until six years later.

n.en: Russian State Arctic and Antarctic Museum

items.d: 1 mile round-trip. Starting at the Wetherill Mesa Kiosk, this trail ends at an overlook of Nordenskiold Site No. 16, one of the first excavated sites in Mesa Verde.
Located in a single-story building with a yellow roof
A museum with a collection of miniature items collected by Nicolai Siadristy. A large number of Matryoshka dolls, miniature art, decorated Easter egg and more.
Beautiful house of worship built by the French in 1910, renovated in 2004.
Amusement park.

Climb to the Dome summit overlooking the Crater Lake. The crater may erupt at any time. As of May 2016 the Department of Conservation recommends not going beyond the Dome equipment shed, or inside the crater basin within 400m of…
Beautiful monastery with nice surroundings. It has the Church of Saint Nicholas which was erected in 1734 on the foundation of an older church.

Guided rafting trips on the Arno through the historic centre, passing beneath Ponte Vecchio. Tours last about one hour, require no previous experience and are run in inflatable rafts with an instructor in each boat.
Dilapidated amusement park. Has some old water rides and rollercoasters.
An old wooden building which used to house the district office and court for Tutong District.

n.en: Old Building of Tutong District Office and Court

items.d: With a capacity of 20,000, this is home to Knights team, representing Free State province.

A collection of some 25 art objects, scattered along the coast from Ulvön Island, and westward through the Nätra river valley. The center of the exhibition can be found at Herrgårdsparken in Köpmanholmen.
This 18m-deep artificial reef is made of old vehicles, boats, and industrial debris, and was a popular dive site.It has been closed to general public since 2017.

Formerly the Sarawak State Mosque, Kuching's main mosque. Later it was re-designated as the Kuching Divisional Mosque. It was built in 1968 on a site that had been used for a wooden mosque as early as 1852.
Authentic and less touristy plaza with local food opportunities.
The Kirindy Forest Reserve has the greatest density and diversity of primates in the world. It is also the best western-reserve for seeing Madagascar’s endemic dry forest species.
a typical Dalmatian cave with stalactites and stalagmites, where archeological findings, especially engraved and colored ceramics, have been made and prove neolithic settlement of the island
The oldest garden in Fes, created by Sultan Moulay Abdallah in 18th century. It features 3000 plant species, some of them are quite rare.
Mosque founded by C.W.W. Kannangara Mawatha.
Monastery belonging to the Greek-Melkite Catholic Church.
A church with impressive large dome. You need a passport to get in.
Located in Lisbjerg on Aarhus' northern outskirts, this is a large, authentic Japanese garden laid out in traditional chisen kaiyu style designed for promenading.
Can be reached from above or below, on top side there is beautiful view of area, while below you can walk through picturesque ponds and bushes.

Saaremaa’s largest bog. The study trail is about 4.8–5.7 km with information boards and several viewpoints. Some sections can be wet depending on season; waterproof footwear is recommended. Cranberries can be found in autumn.
One of the three gate-towers of Vratnik, controlling the road east towards Visegrad and Istanbul. It was built 1727-1739 in limestone and Bosnian stone hreša with roof shingles.
Military cemetery in the town of Ypres with 198 Commonwealth soldiers buried next to the Lille Gate (Rijselpoort).
Operated by the Mediterranean Institute and curated by Jan Simič, the museum has a collection of 3,000 shells and aquatic creatures on display, including exotic ones.

Among the 12 fountains there are: Geyser (Гейзер), Heroes of Fairy Tales (Герои сказок), Four Seasons (Четыре времени года), symbolized by bronze horses, the Curtain (Завеса), is just behind the former.
A place to relax and people-watch or eat at a cafe along the waterfront.
A pedestrian street with several 17th- to 20th-century buildings, interesting doors and special windows.
Home to more than 45,000 animals across 60 different exhibits, this is the Middle East's largest aquarium.
Showcasing findings from Susa.
Fort was built to protect against western approaches. It was constructed upon the ruins of a much older fort, on Abu Mahir island. Fort is rest against the coastline and give beautiful sea views.
Tomb for much loved country freedom fighter.
The largest mosque in Quba, also made of bricks and multicoloured, was built in the early 19th century by Haji Jeffer.
